old_row.rationale: Both describe a giant in renewed war with six digits on each extremity, twenty-four altogether. Chronicles leaves the man unnamed at Geth; Samuel calls him Madon at Gath and describes his descent from Rapha.

new_row.rationale: Both describe a giant in renewed war with twenty-four digits. Chronicles says six and six and leaves the man unnamed at Geth; Samuel calls him Madon at Gath and explicitly describes six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. changes.reason: Preserve the source's six-and-six wording rather than importing the target's explicit hands and feet.
